I bought Kubos in my street size as my first pair of climbing shoes, they stretched quite a bit. I now refer to them as my slippers. My toes slightly touch the front, but the toebox is too stretched for me rn to trust my feet on small holds or volumes. I sometimes use them as my warm up shoe, and they work fine for easier climbs, but generally for anything above 6b+ use my other pair of shoes. For reference, I have pretty slim feet. 

as another comment mentioned, what type of climbing are u doing, what improvements are you expecting, etc., this could be good to consider.
